title: The Anniversary Bonus
intro: Chapter 2, Toddy: free money. The oldest bait there is.
A text says you were "chosen" for a bonus from an app you have barely used.
Tap anything that looks odd, then decide.

notify.text: You won 200 ZLX! Claim before it expires…

screen.context: You have not entered any contest.

msg.text: Connect your wallet to receive it.

prize.label: Free coins out of nowhere
prize.lens: You did nothing to earn 200 ZLX.
prize.why: Surprise free money is bait. The prize is a hook, not a gift.

link.label: Look-alike link
link.why: Only the real domain is Zelvora. A different ending is a copy.

connect.label: "Connect your wallet"
connect.lens: A fake site can ask your wallet to sign away your coins.
connect.why: "Connect to claim" is how many wallets get drained.

timer.label: Expires soon
timer.why: Pressure is there to stop you from checking.

few.label: "One of 500 chosen"
few.lens: A flattering number you cannot check.

sender.label: Zelvora Rewards
sender.why: A sender name proves nothing, anyone can type one.

time.label: Sent at 5:20 PM
time.why: Scam texts arrive at any hour.

actions.label: Check Zelvora's own app for any anniversary bonus
Delete it and report the text as junk

trap.title: Zelvora · Anniversary Bonus
trap.ask: Connect your wallet and approve to receive 200 ZLX.

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. Your phone company can block more of these texts.

verify.line: The app mentioned no bonus at all. The text was fake. Case cracked.
verify.mirageSays: Hmph. They opened the real app.

ignore.line: You ignored it safely. Reporting would help protect the next person.

go_ahead.line: The "claim" approved the site to empty your wallet. The ZLX never came, and the coins you owned left.

what_if.go_ahead: Checking the real app first would have shown no bonus anywhere.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the text helps others.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring it was safe. A quick report protects others.

golden_rule: Never "connect your wallet" to claim a surprise prize. Check the real app or site first.

quick_check.q: A text says you were chosen for a free crypto bonus and must connect your wallet on a link. What do you do?

options.text: Do not click. Check the real app and report the text

quick_check.explain: Surprise prizes plus "connect your wallet" is the classic drainer bait.

hints.nudge: Did you enter anything to win this?

rows.v: Appear inside the app, never by surprise text
